svg.aria-label: Featured project: Manhwadle, a daily character-guessing game across twelve webtoons. 1,063 characters, Windows, macOS, Linux and web; Electron, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare.
svg.title: Featured project: Manhwadle, a daily character-guessing game across twelve webtoons. 1,063 characters, Windows, macOS, Linux and web; Electron, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare.

g.text: Playable in the browser · solo project
Each guess is compared to the mystery character in
9 categories, while the constellations comment on
your run. Every character has a difficulty rank, and
the web novels can join Infinite mode. Desktop app,
browser version and installable on mobile.
